# UI icons

- Bilibili and NetEase Cloud Music brand marks: [Simple Icons v15](https://simpleicons.org/), CC0. Brand marks identify their respective sources; no affiliation is implied.
- Generic interface icons: [Lucide Static v0.468.0](https://lucide.dev/), ISC (see LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt).

Assets are copied to `static/icons/` and served locally; the UI does not require external icon services.
